card.name: Digits just before a final 1 in percentages
card.fires_on: A digit, decimal point or space inside a number, usually a percentage in adverse-event counts, where the next character is likely to be a 1 (as in 11%, 1.1%, 2.1%).

modes.label: Before a repeated 1
modes.description: First digit of a two-digit percentage such as 11%, in patient-count comparisons.

modes.label: Decimal point before 1
modes.description: The decimal point in a percentage or weight where a 1 follows.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the digit 1 (and similar forms of one or eleven) as the next character.
card.plain: It fires inside a number in a trial result when the next digit is probably a 1.
